# Introduction

This document generates descriptive statistics underpinning the geomobility classification.

```{r}
# Load ProjectTemplate
library(ProjectTemplate)
load.project()
```

We load the data set we have generated using the scripts in the `munge` section, specifically:

- `./munge/01_var_mapping.R`
- `./munge/02_var_travel.R`

These scripts clean demographic and travel-related variables from the NTS dataset and generate a new dataset called `nts_combined_variables.parquet`, which contains demo and travel information at individual level.

```{r}
# Load necessary data
nts_combined <- read_parquet('./data/processed/nts_combined_variables.parquet')
```

We will keep 2024 observations only. These can be filtered from the first 4 digits of the `PSUID` variable.
